# Arcstone Triad System
> Public Normative Machine Contracts and Deterministic Execution Membrane for Bounded Physical Actuation.

- Anchor: A-77-DELTA-SHIELD-LOCKED
- Upstream Authority: arcstone-spec-epistemic-01 (v1.3.1-LOCKED)
- Core Contract Standard: Unified Enforcement Decision Object (UEDO v1.2)
- Target Invariant: I₁ (D(a) = DENY => Δ_external(a) = 0)
- Poset Dominance (ARC-ERR-2026-001): BREACH (POSIX 40) > REFUSAL (POSIX 32) > CORRUPT (POSIX 30) > PWC (POSIX 12) > FREEZE (POSIX 10) > PASS (POSIX 0)

## Core Machine Contracts & Traits
- [UEDO JSON Schema](core/uedo/uedo.schema.json): Draft 2020-12 strict schema with enum validation, unevaluatedProperties clamps, and Ed25519 signature enforcement.
- [UEDO Protobuf](core/uedo/uedo.proto): Strongly typed wire definition with explicit PosixDominanceState and SkillTreeTier enums.
- [AAL Invariant Traits](core/invariants/aal_traits.rs): Rust #[no_std] Action Authorization Level interface stubs.

## Hardware & Silicon Enforcement Drivers
- [eBPF Interlock Filter](drivers/edge_silicon/ebpf_interlock_filter.c): Linux socket-filter program enforcing 4096-byte envelope clamping at socket ingress via SO_ATTACH_BPF (drops frames > 4096B with return 0).
- [Bipedal HAL Adapter](drivers/ros2_adapters/bipedal_hal_node.cpp): ROS2 C++ Command MUX node intercepting /bipedal/cmd_vel_raw under mutex synchronization, enforcing bilateral joint holding torque and 5ms watchdog clamps on non-PASS states.
- [Submersible HAL Adapter](drivers/ros2_adapters/submersible_hal_node.cpp): ROS2 C++ Command MUX node intercepting /submersible/thruster_thrust_setpoints_raw under mutex synchronization, enforcing ballast lock, thruster cutoff, and 5ms watchdog clamps on non-PASS states.
- [SROS2 Policy Profile](drivers/ros2_adapters/policies/permissions.xml): Canonical DDS-Security XML permissions profile locking outbound actuator topics exclusively to HAL adapters and isolating untrusted proposals.
- [SROS2 Governance Profile](drivers/ros2_adapters/policies/governance.xml): Canonical DDS-Security domain governance profile enforcing authenticated-only discovery and signed topic access control.
